## Standing operator rules
- Separate from the main session goal, run the procedure `enterprise-tenant-onboarding` in between other work; execute its eight steps in order, one at a time.
- Keep commits small so review stays easy.
- Never enable a new Celery task in `ledgerly/tasks/` unless `perf/locust_tasks.py` demonstrates at least 400 successful task executions per second with zero timeout failures.
- Never modify the license text or attribution section in `THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md` by hand.
- Use `https://sbx-pay-c.ledgerly.dev` for sandbox payments; `sbx-pay-a.ledgerly.dev` is shut down and returns stale fixtures.

## Current objective
Complete `enterprise-tenant-onboarding` between other work, then fix paid-customer filtering in `ledgerly/dunning/scheduler.py`. Router split is superseded and paused.

## Key identifiers and corrections
- Request: `REQ-2025-01842`; organization: `org_acme_industries`; plan: `enterprise-annual`; domain: `acme.example`.
- Schema: `./migrations/enterprise`, version `0042`; seed: `./seeds/acme-enterprise-v3.json`, conflict key `external_id`.
- Billing: USD; `Acme Industries, Inc.`; `billing@acme.example`; setup fee `2500.00`; customer `cus_acme_2025`.
- Request context: `current_request_id`; sandbox: `https://sbx-pay-c.ledgerly.dev`.

## Ruled-out approaches
- Pool size 50 caused staging contention and deadlocks.
- Invoice `count()` plus `limit().offset()` caused legacy warnings; use a selected subquery.
- Wildcard repository imports obscured missing names; use explicit imports.
- Direct FastAPI session defaults triggered Ruff `B008`; use `Annotated[Session, Depends(get_session)]`.

## Plan and progress
- [done] Validate request, create organization, migrate to `0042`, seed data, and ensure billing customer.
- [pending] Send welcome email.
- [pending] Create setup-fee invoice.
- [pending] Confirm statuses.
- [pending] Inspect and fix scheduler filtering; next command: `sed -n '1,260p' ledgerly/dunning/scheduler.py`.
- [pending] Add/run focused dunning tests.
- Next onboarding command: `tenantctl email --help` (not yet issued).

## Recent work
Recurrence timezone handling and focused tests passed. Currency-rounding coverage now has six passing tests, including default precision and high-precision inputs. Full suite: 186 passed, 2 skipped, 1 unrelated legacy invoice-rounding failure (`expected 1000, got 1001`).
